title: kith-tui: resync missed changes after SSE reconnect
description: Found in rehearsal2 (2026-10-30): when the EventSource stream reconnects, kith-tui does not fetch changes made while disconnected; they appear only with the next state event. On conference wifi, messages sent by others during a drop stay invisible. Fix: on reconnect, run Chat/changes and Message/changes from the last server-issued states (RFC 8620 §5.2), falling back to a full reload on cannotCalculateChanges.
notes:
Root cause: nothing triggered /changes after reconnect. chinwag replays only for a Last-Event-ID (events.rs: seen = Last-Event-ID or current), and kith-tui has none before its first state event and drops ids seen on a connection that ends in Err (rehearsal2: 'error decoding response body'). Fix: every SseStatus::Connected queues Chat+Message catch-up into pending (reuses handle_state_change, backoff, replace-by-id); RFC 8620 §7.1 equal-state skip (new chat_state) makes a server replay after the catch-up free. Tests: reconnect_fetches_message_missed_while_disconnected, reconnect_without_changes_costs_one_round (both failed before fix).
Live check rehearsal3 (chinwag main e825c83, kith 28131e0, ports 18080/18443): two clients, socat killed ~10 s, carol sent via direct HTTP during the drop; after restore both clients showed it 4 s later, exactly once; 10 requests per client within 90 ms of reconnect, then 0 in 10 s idle.
